def _score_tfc_bm25plus(tf_array, l_d, l_avg, k1, b, delta):
    num = (k1 + 1) * tf_array
    den = k1 * (1 - b + b * l_d / l_avg) + tf_array
    return (num / den) + delta

    term = (tf_num / (tf_den + tf)) + 0.5
    IDF = math.log((N + 1) / df)
